scripts.build:apk: pnpm --filter @fivethreeone/mobile exec eas build --platform android --profile preview --local --non-interactive --output ../web/public/531-preview.apk
scripts.ci: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check-boundaries && pnpm check-line-heights && pnpm check-temp-markers && pnpm test
scripts.verify: pnpm run ci && pnpm bundle-check && pnpm build:web
scripts.release-ota: pnpm --filter @fivethreeone/mobile exec eas update --branch main --platform android --environment production --non-interactive --message "$(git log -1 --pretty=%s)"
